clean_story:
Now I will teach you Water. It is the clear, wet stuff that falls from the sky when clouds cry. It fills the holes in the ground where we drink. It makes things slippery and cold. It can be still like a sleeping beast or move like a running animal. It carries small bits of earth when it runs fast. You see it in the river, the lake, this is Water.

Discover now: rain, river, stone.
